title: Change an OpenAPI document (contract first)
caption: packages/api-types/README.md and packages/errors/README.md; AGENTS.md §6. Never edit src/generated/ by hand.

steps.title: Edit the document
steps.body: `ota/backend/openapi/velexis-ota-booking-api.openapi.yaml` or `platform/backend/openapi/velexis-platform-api.openapi.yaml`. A new error code goes into `x-error-catalogue` with `status` and `description`; a code with field errors also needs an example with `fieldErrors` and an entry in `FIELD_ERROR_CODES`.

steps.title: Lint
steps.expect: No errors (warnings are printed, not fatal). A `.redocly.lint-ignore.yaml` fails the run.

steps.title: Generate
steps.expect: `wrote` for `packages/api-types/src/generated/{ota,platform,operations}.ts` and `packages/errors/src/generated/catalogue.ts`; a code with different statuses in the two documents fails and writes nothing.

steps.title: Use it
steps.body: Handlers, route parity (operations index), SDK route table (`ota/sdk`), `expectResponseToMatch` in integration tests.

steps.title: Commit together
steps.body: Document + generated files in one commit.
steps.expect: CI re-runs the generators and fails on any diff (`git diff --exit-code -- packages/api-types packages/errors`).
